say:1:1322034001:1.source_cn: 那个……魔法师大人，可以请您帮个忙吗？

say:2:1322034002:0.text: Oh, what's your problem, good sir? Is it an enemy invasion or a local crime boss? Oh, could it be you lost a fight or lost someone you love? No matter how difficult the problem, Sir Chippy will always lend a helping hand!
say:2:1322034002:0.source_cn: 噢，这位无辜之人，你遇到了什么难题？是敌人侵略还是强盗...

say:3:1322034003:1.text: Oh, you're so embarrassing, Chippy. Is it because of those fantasy books I've been reading to you at night?
say:3:1322034003:1.source_cn: ……太丢人了，满满。你最近是不是又看骑士小说了？

say:4:1322034004:0.text: Ummm... it's not as complicated as what the hamster knight said. It's just that I saw a Graveborn outside of Cedartown during my patrol.
say:4:1322034004:0.source_cn: 呃……也没仓鼠骑士说的这么复杂。只是刚才我带队巡逻的时...

say:5:1322034005:1.text: I don't know his name, but he's tall and skinny and has a sword stabbed through his body. He's pretty scary-looking...
say:5:1322034005:1.source_cn: 我不太清楚他的名字，就是瘦瘦高高，身上还插着一把剑，看...

say:6:1322034006:1.text: Sounds like Igor... He's not dangerous. He just likes to fool around.
say:6:1322034006:1.source_cn: ……听起来是伊戈尔？他最喜欢和别人一起玩耍了！

say:7:1322034007:1.text: Yes, that one! He likes to play pranks on people.
say:7:1322034007:1.source_cn: 对对对，就是那个喜欢找人玩，到处搞恶作剧的亡灵！

say:8:1322034008:1.text: Actually, everyone knows he doesn't have any bad intentions. He's just an odd ball that likes to play with people. However, his appearance scares most folks.
say:8:1322034008:1.source_cn: 咳，其实这段时间大家也都渐渐知道了，他没什么坏心思，就...

say:9:1322034009:1.text: I saw him outside just now and was worried he was going to run into town again and scare the children. He's done it before...
say:9:1322034009:1.source_cn: 刚才我在外面看到他，担心他晚上又会跑进镇子来，吓到小孩...

say:10:1322034010:1.text: It's usually not a big deal, but recently, with the strange incidents of children being taken at night, everyone's on edge.
say:10:1322034010:1.source_cn: 放在其他时候还好，但前阵子镇上才出了小孩子半夜被带走的...

say:11:1322034011:1.text: If Igor causes trouble again, I'm worried someone might overreact. It wouldn't be good to have a conflict with the Graveborn again.
say:11:1322034011:1.source_cn: 要是那个伊戈尔这时候再闹腾，我怕会有人反应过激。万一再...

say:12:1322034012:1.text: So, you need the help of Sir Chippy!

say:13:1322034013:1.text: Right, yes... So, Magister, I heard from Captain Rodrigo that you are very familiar with the Graveborn in these parts. I'm hoping you can go talk to Igor and ask him not to play in Cedartown during this time.
say:13:1322034013:1.source_cn: 呃，是的……魔法师大人，听罗德里戈大人说您和这里的亡灵...
